correspondence: lean/docs/024.md (SHA-256 13056416c388c8fa) names as its accompanying paper(s) “An asymptotic formula for the number of totients”, lists the comparator statement lean/ComparatorChallenges/TotientAsymptotic.lean (SHA-256 c0be7ff8588f6d0b) for “Totient-count asymptotics and regular variation”, and says: “Let $V(x)$ count the distinct values of Euler's totient function up to $x$. The formalization constructs the paper's explicit positive main term from finite arithmetic approximants and proves that their ratio tends to one. In particular, $V(cx)/V(x)\to c$ for every fixed $c>0$, answering the Erdős–Hall regular-variation question.” “The formalization also gives asymptotics for totients $v\le x$ whose least preimage $\ell(v)=\min\{n\ge1:\varphi(n)=v\}$ lies between $kx$ and $(k+1)x$. The associated coefficient is positive under the stated existence condition; when no totient $d$ satisfies $kd<\ell(d)$, the count and coefficient are identically zero. The cases $k=1,2$ have positive coefficients.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
exact_statement:
theorem weighted_totient_one_two
    :
    ∀ k∈({1,2} : Finset ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧
      ∀ s∈Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, c≤A (fk k) s
